title: Autonomous Neural Adaptive Control as a Self-Consistent Transfer Operator (Numerical Reproduction Suite)
description: Official simulation suite, Ulam-Galerkin transfer-operator discretization solvers, statistical linear-response verification scripts, precomputed Monte Carlo datasets, and figure generation scripts for the paper 'Autonomous Neural Adaptive Control as a Self-Consistent Transfer Operator' by Stefano Galatolo and Vittorio Lippi (submitted to Journal of Nonlinear Science). Reproduces all numerical experiments in Section 8, including autonomous online adaptation, multi-timescale exponential relaxation, Proposition 7.7 Tikhonov regularization shifts, linear-response decomposition D\overline{G}(\theta_*) = H_* + C_* R_* B_*, weak vs. persistent stochastic excitation, two-phase deployment Action Error recovery, loss of linear stability across \delta_c, and non-convex neural MLP compensation.
